evals.name: greenfield-vite-no-compose
evals.prompt: Set up the devcontainer for this repo so I can run claude inside it instead of on my laptop.
evals.expected_output: A .devcontainer/ with claude-code + node features, a named volume for ~/.claude, and postCreateCommand.sh with the credsStore/chown/symlink fixes. Should NOT add docker-in-docker (nothing in the repo runs containers). Should notice the Vite dev server binds localhost and needs --host.

evals.name: existing-devcontainer-patch
evals.prompt: We already have a devcontainer here but claude isn't in it. Add it, and use a per-project volume - this is client code and I don't want it sharing credentials with my other repos.
evals.expected_output: Patches the existing devcontainer.json rather than overwriting it: adds the claude-code feature, adds the mount with source=${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}-claude-config, creates postCreateCommand.sh. Should catch that the existing top-level "extensions" key is the deprecated schema and move it under customizations.vscode. Should preserve the existing java feature and settings.

evals.name: python-compose-nonvscode-user
evals.prompt: set this up to run the agent in a container. we need the postgres from compose working inside it too
evals.expected_output: Swaps the node feature for python:1, keeps docker-in-docker (compose is present), and mounts the config volume at the correct remote user's home for the chosen base image rather than blindly using /home/vscode. Forwards port 8000 from the uvicorn dev command.
